description: D-13 public vendor datasets for calibrating the header reader (R4-OR-05) and the pixel sampler (R4-OR-06). Chosen by the owner at Gate G1 on 2026-11-24. Each archive is GitHub's zip of the pinned commit (codeload.github.com/neurolabusc/<repo>/zip/<commit>); its SHA-256 was computed on download on 2026-11-24. GitHub does not promise byte-stable archives, so a checksum mismatch in CI is reported, never silently accepted. Layout of each archive: <repo>-<commit>/In/<series folder>/ (DICOM) and <repo>-<commit>/Ref/ (the reference dcm2niix output: '-b y -z n', '-l' left at its default 'o', per the repository's batch.sh).

datasets.license_check: LICENSE file present in the archive ('BSD 2-Clause License'): use, modification and redistribution allowed with the copyright notice and disclaimer. Fetching the data for test calibration, without redistributing it, is within those terms.
datasets.content: GE DICOM: four axial DWI tensor series (several acceleration factors), a 3D axial MP-RAGE, and slice-timing series

datasets.license_check: LICENSE file present in the archive ('BSD 2-Clause License'); same terms as above.
datasets.content: Siemens XA30 DICOM. Checked on 2026-11-24: every MR object is enhanced multi-frame (SOP classes Enhanced MR Image and Enhanced MR Color Image, up to 96 frames), plus a raw-data and an SR object. The lab's XA data are classic exports (scan-selection.md 2.2), so this set exercises only the multiframe path.
datasets.scope: Kept by the owner at G1 (2026-11-24) with limited scope: R4-OR-05 compares only Manufacturer and MagneticFieldStrength (every other field is not comparable for enhanced objects) and confirms the multiframe flag; R4-OR-06 reports every series 'not compared'.

datasets.license_check: LICENSE file present in the archive ('BSD 2-Clause License'); same terms as above.
datasets.content: GE epi_pepolar: four field-map series with forward and reverse phase encoding

accepted_discrepancies_reason: Accepted by the owner at G1 (2026-11-24): the header reader reports the DICOM RepetitionTime, as scan-selection.md 5.1 defines tr_ms; dcm2niix writes an adjusted TR in these six GE slice-timing references (their names carry the group delay: GD33 -> 2.033 s, GD55 -> 2.055 s, GD3s -> 5 s, 0.35Delay -> 1.35 s). An expected difference, excluded by name.

expected_sampler_statuses.reason: Accepted by the owner at G1 (2026-11-24): GE epi_pepolar mode 1 stores the images with reversed row order and dcm2niix corrects it on purpose (its issue 532); expected, and evidence that the sampler catches a real row flip. Reported through the sampler's named category.
